Thank you for applying for the Staff Backend Engineer role at Stripe. We have received your application and our team is currently reviewing your profile.

You can view the status of your application on our career portal.

The Stripe Recruiting Team

subject: Stripe: Staff Backend Engineer - Let's connect!
snippet: Hi Akshit, I'm Sarah from the technical recruiting team at Stripe. Your profile caught our eye...
body_plain:
Hi Akshit,

I lead backend hiring at Stripe. We were very impressed with your background in distributed systems and would love to chat for 30 minutes to discuss the Staff Backend Engineer position.

Could you let me know if you are free this Thursday at 2:00 PM EST or Friday at 11:00 AM EST?

Looking forward to speaking!

Sarah Connor
Technical Recruiter | Stripe

subject: Stripe Next Steps: Technical Assessment Invitation
snippet: Great chatting with you! As discussed, the next step is our hands-on systems assessment...
body_plain:
Hi Akshit,

It was great speaking with you earlier! The team wants to move forward to the technical assessment phase. Here is the link to complete our 90-minute systems design evaluation:

https://assessment.stripe.com/take/xyz890

Please complete this assessment by next Tuesday, 5:00 PM EST.

Best of luck!
Sarah Connor

subject: Congratulations! Offer from Stripe
snippet: We are thrilled to extend an offer for the Staff Backend Engineer position at Stripe!
body_plain:
Dear Akshit,

On behalf of everyone at Stripe, we are thrilled to formally extend an offer of employment for the position of Staff Backend Engineer in Seattle/Remote!

Base Salary: $235,000
Equity: $400,000 RSU over 4 years
Sign-on Bonus: $30,000

Please review the attached offer letter and let us know your decision by next Monday.

Warm regards,
Sarah Connor

subject: Exciting Engineering Opportunities at Google Cloud
snippet: I came across your GitHub and open source work and wanted to connect regarding Staff roles at Google...
body_plain:
Hi Akshit,

I hope you're having a great week! My name is Michael Jordan and I'm a Senior Recruiter on the Google Cloud Infrastructure team.

I was really impressed by your background in asynchronous queue processing and scalability. We are actively hiring Staff Software Engineers for our Cloud Storage team in Mountain View and New York.

Are you open to exploring new roles? If so, I'd love to share more details over a quick call.

Best,
Michael Jordan
Google Cloud Talent Team
